lifestyle.title: A life in
lifestyle.p1: Koh Samui is not just a destination — it's a way of being. Wake to birdsong and the scent of frangipani. Spend mornings in your private pool or on a yoga platform overlooking the jungle canopy.
lifestyle.p2: Harmony Life developments are designed around wellness — with saunas, ice baths, meditation zones, and tropical gardens that nourish the soul as much as the body.

founder.p1: With over 10 years in premium residential development and 150+ completed projects across Warsaw, Robert arrived on Koh Samui not as a developer looking for opportunity — but as someone who fell in love with the island and wanted to build something worthy of it.
founder.p2: His philosophy is simple: build every home as if his own family will live there. European structural standards, premium materials, and meticulous attention to detail — these are non-negotiables. Combined with a deep respect for the natural beauty and culture of Koh Samui, the result is Harmony Life.
founder.quote: On Koh Samui I build homes with European care — the kind you want to stay in and, one day, pass on to your children. In a place I simply fell in love with.

testimonials.title: Words from our owners
testimonials.subtitle: Hear from the international investors and lifestyle buyers who have chosen Harmony Life.
testimonials.t1Quote: We purchased a 2BR villa at Harmony Life One before construction finished and the experience exceeded every expectation. The build quality genuinely rivals what we've seen in Switzerland — Robert's attention to detail is extraordinary.
testimonials.t2Quote: As an experienced real estate investor, I was initially sceptical. But seeing European-standard insulation and ventilation in a tropical climate convinced me. We're generating consistent rental yield while the family uses it as a holiday base. Exactly what we wanted.
testimonials.t3Quote: From the first consultation to the handover, Harmony Life was professional and transparent. We live in Singapore and the property management takes care of everything. Our investment practically runs itself.
testimonials.t4Quote: I've invested in Thailand before and been burned by poor construction. Harmony Life is categorically different. The founder's European background shows in every corner. Truly exceptional.

about.heroSubtitle: From Warsaw's most demanding residential projects to the hillsides of Koh Samui — a story of craft, vision, and uncompromising standards.
about.storyP1: Harmony Life was born from a love affair with Koh Samui and a refusal to accept the construction standards that dominated the island's luxury market.
about.storyP2: Founder Robert Szymański spent over a decade building premium residential properties in Warsaw — developing the expertise, systems, and supplier relationships that define European build quality. When he discovered Koh Samui, he saw an island of extraordinary beauty paired with a real estate market that was failing its buyers.
about.storyP3: Harmony Life is the answer: every development engineered and constructed to the standards Robert demanded in Warsaw, set within the natural splendour of Thailand's most beloved island.
about.value1Desc: European construction standards — non-negotiable. Every material, every joint, every finish is selected and installed to the highest European specifications.
about.value2Desc: Every project is designed to exist in balance — with nature, with the local community, and with the aspirations of our buyers and their families.
about.value3Desc: Koh Samui's natural beauty is not a backdrop — it is an active design element. We build around it, preserve it, and celebrate it in every project.
about.value4Desc: Harmony Life is more than properties — it's a community of like-minded people who value quality, lifestyle, and authentic tropical living.
about.teamFounderBio: 10+ years premium residential development in Warsaw. Visionary behind Harmony Life.
about.teamMember2Bio: Dedicated to ensuring every buyer has a seamless and personalised investment journey.
about.teamMember3Bio: Oversees every build to European standards, from foundations to finishing.
about.teamMember4Bio: Manages all rental operations and owner services with precision and care.
about.ctaSubtitle: From sold-out successes to the latest launches — discover why Harmony Life is the benchmark for luxury living on Koh Samui.
about.founderHeading: A builder at heart, an islander by choice
about.founderBio1: Born in Gdańsk and trained as an engineer and project manager, Robert began his career in residential construction in Warsaw in the early 2000s. Through careful craftsmanship and an absolute refusal to cut corners, he built one of the most respected portfolios in Poland's luxury residential sector.
about.founderBio2: His projects were known for structural longevity, energy efficiency decades ahead of regulation, and a level of finish that justified premium prices. Buyers knew: if Robert built it, it would last.
about.founderBio3: The move to Koh Samui in 2019 was not retirement — it was expansion. Robert identified an underserved market: international buyers and investors who wanted tropical luxury but demanded European standards of construction. Not aesthetics only, but genuinely superior buildings.
about.founderBio4: Today, Harmony Life operates five projects on the island, and Robert personally oversees quality control on every development. His philosophy hasn't changed: build it as if your family will live there.
about.founderQuote: Koh Samui is paradise. But paradise deserves buildings that last a generation, not five years. That's what we build.

harmony-life-hill.tagline: Hillside Pool Villas — Fully Sold Out
harmony-life-hill.description: 6 exclusive hillside villas with panoramic ocean views — sold out. Perched above the island with breath-taking views.
harmony-life-hill.longDescription: Harmony Life Hill is a complex of exclusive villas set on the hills of Koh Samui, each with panoramic views of the ocean and tropical landscape. Every villa features 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, 240 m² of living space, a private pool, and terraces with spectacular views. harmony-life-hill-2.longDescription: Harmony Life Hill 2 builds on the success of the first phase, offering 5 even more spacious and luxurious villas. Each property features 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, 200 m² of living space, a private infinity pool, and expansive terraces with panoramic views of the ocean and tropical landscape. The project combines modern design with tropical elements and the finest finishing materials.

harmony-life-oasis.description: A tropical oasis of 53 exclusive sea-view villas in diverse layouts from 1 to 4 bedrooms — for every investor and lifestyle buyer.

The development provides a wide range of layouts — from 1 to 4 bedrooms, with areas from 90 to 345 m² — each with breath-taking sea views. Onsite amenities include an exclusive café and a professional kids club, making this project ideal for both investors seeking rental yields and families planning to live on Koh Samui permanently.

solaya-residence.description: Modern 2–3 bedroom sea-view villas in Plai Laem — European build quality, fully managed by Harmony Life.
solaya-residence.longDescription: SOLAYA Residence is a new Harmony Life villa project in the prestigious Plai Laem district of Koh Samui: 2–3 bedroom villas, including a flagship type with a private rooftop terrace. Every villa has a sea or panoramic view, a private pool and tropical garden. harmony-life-wellness.tagline: Wellness, Spa & Café — by individual arrangement
harmony-life-wellness.description: A wellness sanctuary with spa, massage and an artisan café — for the residents and guests of Harmony Life. Available by individual arrangement, not a standard investment unit.
harmony-life-wellness.longDescription: Harmony Life Wellness & Caffe is the calm, social heart of the Harmony Life world — a dedicated space for spa rituals, massage and body treatments, sauna and ice-bath recovery, and an artisan café to slow down in. It is designed for our owners and their guests, wellness travellers, and anyone on Koh Samui looking for genuine balance and rest. This is not a standard investment unit — any involvement is arranged individually, case by case. Reach out and we will walk you through the options.

guide.heroTitle: How to safely buy an investment property on Koh Samui
guide.heroSubtitle: From reservation through ownership structure to rental management and resale — the whole process, explained step by step.
guide.whyText: Buying property in Thailand differs from buying in Europe — land-ownership rules, legal structures and procedures are different. We have prepared a clear guide that walks through the whole process, so you know exactly what you are buying and on what terms.
guide.flSubtitle: The two core structures in Thailand — and what we use at Harmony Life.
guide.ownText: For international investors the core structure is leasehold — a long-term right to use the property under a registered lease agreement. Depending on the project, you receive a full set of documents covering your right to the property, the rules of use and your participation in the rental programme.
guide.ownNote: In selected cases a Thai-company structure can be analysed — always with an independent lawyer. We recommend transparent solutions, compliant with Thai law and matched to the specific property type.
guide.processTitle: The buying process, step by step
guide.processSubtitle: A transparent path — from choosing the property to handover into rental management.

steps.title: Choosing the property
steps.text: You choose a villa or apartment and receive the full information set: location, layout, price, payment schedule, completion date and the legal model.

steps.title: Reservation
steps.text: You sign a simple reservation agreement and pay a reservation fee that takes the property off the market and locks the price.

steps.title: Due diligence
steps.text: You verify the documents — on your own or with an independent lawyer. We share land documents, permits, agreements and the schedule.

steps.title: Main agreement
steps.text: After verification you sign the main agreement: developer, leasehold and rental-management.

steps.title: Staged payments
steps.text: You pay in stages according to an individual schedule linked to construction progress.

steps.title: Construction & updates
steps.text: You receive construction-progress updates — photos and milestone reports, with a dedicated investor contact.

steps.title: Handover
steps.text: You check the finish standard, note any snags, sign the handover protocol and receive the keys and documents.

steps.title: Rental management
steps.text: If you choose the investment model, the property is taken under the team’s care and prepared for rental.

guide.costsNote: Before signing, you receive an estimated breakdown of the additional costs for the specific property. Annual local taxes are usually relatively low compared with Europe, but they depend on the property and current regulations.
guide.rentalText: We don’t just sell property — we build an ecosystem in which your property can work for you while remaining part of a well-kept space. Rentals are handled by the local Harmony Life team on Koh Samui.
guide.rentalSettlement: The recommended model is quarterly net settlement — after agreed operating costs and commissions are deducted, you receive a report and the amount due to the owner.
rentalReport: Net revenue and the owner’s amount
guide.rentalOwnerUse: You can also use the property yourself — the terms and availability (including high season) are set out in the agreement.
guide.exitText: An investment should have a clear entry point and a possible exit path. You can resell your rights to the property in line with the agreement — for leasehold, usually by transferring the rights under the contract.
guide.exitHelp: Harmony Life can support your resale: preparing the listing and photos, presenting to buyers from our investor base, and coordinating with the lawyer and documents.

faq.q: Can a foreigner buy property in Thailand?
faq.a: Yes, but the structure depends on the property type. A foreigner can own a condominium unit within the foreign-quota limit. For villas and houses on land, leasehold — a long-term right to use — is most common.

faq.q: Can I own land on Koh Samui outright?
faq.a: As a rule, a foreigner cannot own land in Thailand directly. That is why villa projects use leasehold or other structures that require individual legal analysis.

faq.q: How long is a leasehold granted for?
faq.a: Typically 30 years. The contract can provide for renewals of further terms, e.g. 2 × 30 years, where the project structure and documents allow. Every contract is worth checking with a lawyer.

It is a widely used structure in Thailand for foreign investment, especially for villas. Safety depends on the quality of the documents, the land status, the contract terms and registration — which is why we recommend verification by an independent lawyer.

faq.q: Can I rent the property to tourists?
faq.a: Yes, if the property is in the rental-management programme and meets the project’s operational requirements. The Harmony Life team handles bookings, guests, cleaning, servicing and settlements.

faq.q: How often do I receive a rental settlement?
faq.a: The recommended model is quarterly net settlement. You receive a report with revenue, costs, occupancy and the amount due to the owner after agreed operating costs are deducted.

faq.q: Can I use the property myself?
faq.a: Yes. Owner-use terms are set out in the agreement — you can book stays for yourself subject to availability and any seasonal limits.
We do not communicate guaranteed income. The property can generate rental revenue, and the amount depends on occupancy, season, pricing, operating costs and market conditions.
Primarily location, finish standard, the tourist season, the view, property size, photo quality, guest reviews, market pricing, marketing, service level and access to project infrastructure.

faq.q: Can I sell the property later?
faq.a: Yes, you can resell your rights in line with the agreement. Harmony Life can support you in preparing the listing, presenting the property and reaching potential buyers.

faq.q: What costs do I bear beyond the price?
faq.a: There may be legal, registration, administrative, banking and translation costs, furnishing costs, common-area fees, utilities, servicing, insurance and rental-management costs. We prepare a detailed breakdown individually.
Yes, we recommend an independent lawyer. Buying property abroad calls for understanding local law, the ownership structure, registration rules and the parties’ obligations.

guide.disclaimer: This guide is general and informational — it is not legal or tax advice. The details of every transaction depend on the specific property, the agreement and current regulations. We recommend verification of the documents by an independent lawyer.
